description: This file implements a lockfile management module for handling file-based locks, including acquiring, releasing, and updating locks with support for stale lock detection and retries.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Checks the modification time and its precision for a given lockfile, caching the precision.

methods.name: getMtime
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the current time, adjusted for the specified precision ('s' or 'ms').

methods.name: getLockFile
methods.description: Determines the lockfile path based on the provided filename and options.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalPath
methods.description: Resolves the canonical path of a file, optionally following symlinks based on options.

methods.name: acquireLock
methods.description: Attempts to create a lock by making a directory; handles stale lock detection and removal.

methods.name: isLockStale
methods.description: Determines if a lock is stale based on its modification time and the stale threshold.

methods.name: removeLock
methods.description: Removes the lock directory, ignoring errors if it does not exist.

methods.name: updateLock
methods.description: Periodically updates the lock's mtime to keep it active, handling errors and stale conditions.

methods.name: setLockAsCompromised
methods.description: Marks a lock as compromised, releases it, and triggers the onCompromised callback.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Main function to acquire a lock on a file, with retries and lock maintenance.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a file, cancelling updates and removing the lock directory.

methods.name: ensureCleanup
methods.description: Sets up cleanup to release all locks on process exit.
